title: The Rust Moths
text: A cloud of moths with wings the color of rust settles over the party, soft as ash, thousands of them. Where they land, iron turns orange and flakes away. A buckle crumbles. A blade begins to bloom with rot.

options.label: Run before they eat the gear down to nothing.

outcomes.text: Most of the gear makes it. Some of the armor does not.

options.label: The most armored draws them off, and gives the moths a feast.

outcomes.text: They feast on that armor until it falls apart, and the rest of you go free.

options.label: The cleverest smokes them off with a fire, to save what iron is left.

outcomes.text: Sleepy moths, drifting down like ash, and their dust is worth something.
